purpose: Fresh official method, reuse and bounded city/suburb selection evidence; no runtime or network acceptance claim.
publisher: Tenancy Services, Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment (MBIE), New Zealand

findings: The tool covers non-government-owned properties represented in bond information for the displayed six-month window. It is a guide and must not alone determine an individual property rent.

The publisher describes rent quartiles as calculated from bonds lodged in the displayed six months. It separately explains the reporting lag as improving completeness by tenancy start date; preserve this wording rather than converting the table into a stock of all existing tenancies.

The green-box total includes all bonds. Each dwelling-type active-bonds count includes only current bonds within that six-month period. Do not use active count as the full denominator for rent quartiles.
Market-rent regions are based on suburbs in the New Zealand Address Dataset (NZAD). No stable numeric NZAD identifier is supplied by the tested tool selector.
Weekly rent figures are rounded. No numeric rounding base or web-table suppression threshold is stated on this methodology page.

House/Townhouse is a self-contained property usually with land. Apartment includes self-contained areas plus shared areas. Boarding House room has shared facilities in a building intended for at least six people; Room is separately rented with shared facilities in a building intended for fewer than six people. Bedsit/Flat includes part of a subdivided building or a dwelling independent of the primary residence.
The tool excludes the most recent month since June 2021. Late lodgements and recording delays cause considerable revisions; absence of a changed daily number is not evidence of stale collection.

licence.required_context: Credit MBIE/Tenancy Services and link the market-rent-explained methodology page when reproducing the figures. Preserve purpose and uncertainty limits.
licence.note: The downloads page expressly requests The Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment as attribution for its downloadable raw data; this consistent publisher attribution is also retained for tool values.

findings: Migration between the legacy and new bond management systems is ongoing. Data remains provisional, may be incomplete and may be revised.
Changes can reflect reclassification, system differences and methodology changes rather than market movement; recent releases may not be comparable with earlier periods.

Fixed random rounding to base three and suppression below five bonds are described for downloadable files using SA2-2019 areas and tenancy start dates. These rules are not independently established for the website NZAD suburb tables and must not be transferred.

The downloads page also describes alternative geometric means and synthetic quartiles for rent analysis. This is not evidence that the web table labelled median/lower quartile/upper quartile uses those alternative measures.
Tool page explicitly says it updates monthly and covers six months excluding the most recent month; its February example covers 1 July through 31 December.

The ordinary public form submits GET location and has a hidden period=42 field in this response. Treat 42 as an opaque interface value, not an observed month, release date, stable geography identifier or a reusable date formula.
Default or geolocated page content cannot establish a requested location; require explicit city-qualified result echo and the actual displayed date range.

discovery.script_behavior: Publisher client script attaches suggestLocations to data-ajaxurl and groups suggestions by data.city.
discovery.raw_script_not_retained: Only hash/bytes/URL metadata retained here; full script remains outside repository and no unrelated embedded configuration values are copied.

selector_contract.ambiguity: Avondale also resolves to Christchurch; never use an unqualified suburb or substitute Christchurch values for Auckland.
selector_contract.access: Two public GETs used ordinary X-Requested-With, Accept and Referer headers; no API key, user cookie or registration.
selector_contract.limit: These tests validate two selected labels, not every NZAD suburb, city geography, nationwide inventory, stable API contract or documented-key API equivalence.

privacy: Full publisher pages and Javascript stay outside the repository because they contain unrelated navigation, contact/footer and other metadata. This note retains only paraphrases, public selector objects and wire hashes/bytes; no individual records.
limitations: No independent rent calculation or survey validation.
No web-table rounding base, missing-marker vocabulary, web suppression threshold, explicit timezone or exact monthly release day established by these methodology pages.
Source-selection checks do not prove Cloudflare accessibility or actual reader numerical correctness.
